name: @thebriangao/totem
description: Your own WHOOP MCP server: 40 tools for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other AI apps. Runs on your computer or your own cloud server.
author: Brian Gao
_scripts_note: All workflows are `totem <command>` (build, dev, dev:http, start, test, typecheck, auth, cloud, local, deploy, logs, ping, …). The only npm steps are `npm install` and, for the one-time build before the CLI is linked, `npx tsc`. See README → Get Started. `prepack` is not a workflow: npm runs it before `npm pack` / `npm publish` (and when installing from a git URL) so the tarball always carries a fresh dist/, which is where `bin` points.

MCP_AUTH_TOKEN.description: The server's own key: 64 random characters. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32` and keep it; `totem auth --url` asks for it.

AUTH_PASSWORD.description: The password you type on totem's sign-in page when Claude, ChatGPT or another app connects. Use 16+ characters.
